title: HistoLens: An LLM-Powered Framework for Multi-Layered Analysis of Historical Texts - A Case Application of Yantie Lun
reasoning: The research utilizes LLMs to analyze historical Chinese ideologies—Confucianism and Legalism—which represent profound ethical, philosophical, and moral systems. The study specifically evaluates how LLMs can extract, classify, and explain these value systems and 'thoughts,' which are central to Chinese moral and intellectual history.
